title: PR #93: fix(sdk): align mirrored TypeScript amount encoding with u128
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

## Root cause
The ecosystem TypeScript mirror declared `amount: bigint` and documented `amount(u128)`, but its `pushU128BE` helper still encoded only 8 bytes and rejected values above `u64::MAX`.

## Fix
Align the mirror with the standalone `atc-sdk` canonical contract: full 16-byte big-endian u128 amount encoding and u128 range validation.
